patch_description: Revert to the higher-scoring multi-scale shared-entangler design (global RY/RZ layers + shared CRZ entangling shells at distances 1, 2, 4 on the 8-qubit ring), which previously scored 0.60 vs the current 0.39 (which used 6 distinct params and underperformed). On top of that proven base, apply the recommended targeted relaxation: keep the nearest-neighbor (d=1) and antipodal (d=4) CRZ shells tied to the shared "theta_ent" parameter, but give the skip-distance (d=2) shell its own independent parameter "theta_ent_mid". This adds only one extra trainable parameter (4 distinct circuit params total instead of 3) while granting the mid-range connectivity shell independent expressivity, which may improve worst-group margin and validation/test generalization without significantly hurting parameter economy.
